mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 4.5% relative to its 10-year moving average compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through lower cost of capital for corporate valuation.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 4.5% over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month consecutive rise in FEDFUNDS above 5.0% triggers aggressive monetary tightening that reduces corporate credit availability and equity valuations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods (FEDFUNDS > 5.0% for 3 months) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in UNRATE and PAYEMS for 2 consecutive months signal labor market overheating that accelerates inflation and forces central bank rate hikes, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE and PAYEMS both decline for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with joint UNRATE/PAYEMS declines over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In late-cycle expansions, HOUST below 1.4 million units signals housing market contraction that reduces household wealth and consumer spending, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of triggered periods (HOUST < 1.4 million) during late-cycle expansions over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: INDPRO above its 12-month moving average indicates robust manufacturing output that supports corporate earnings growth, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through stronger economic activity.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO > 12-month MA over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month consecutive rise in UNRATE above 5.0% signals labor market deterioration that reduces consumer spending and corporate revenue growth, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods (UNRATE > 5.0% for 3 months) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A 3-month consecutive decline in RSAFS below its 12-month moving average signals weakening consumer demand that reduces corporate sales growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS declines below 12-month moving average for 3 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 45% of triggered periods (RSAFS below 12-month MA for 3 months) over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In supply chain disruption regimes, INDPRO below 100 (index) signals manufacturing contraction that reduces corporate profit margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100 during supply chain disruption events over any 3-year rolling window.
